text:
Which statement about ultrasound is correct?
A
It is produced by a rapidly vibrating source.
B
It is uncomfortable to human ears.
C
Its frequency must be greater than 300kHz.
D
It travels the fastest in a vacuum.

options.label: A
options.text: It is produced by a rapidly vibrating source.

options.label: B
options.text: It is uncomfortable to human ears.

options.label: C
options.text: Its frequency must be greater than 300kHz.

options.label: D
options.text: It travels the fastest in a vacuum.
